grades.quote: TLB refill exception: This exception is triggered when the virtual address of an access operation does not have a match in the TLB, which notifies the system software to perform a TLB refill.
grades.reason: The passage separates the two cases for LoongArch. A TLB miss (no matching entry) raises a TLB refill exception so software can refill the TLB. An entry that is present but invalid (V=0) raises a separate page invalid exception. A missing TLB entry is therefore not the same as an invalid mapping.
